Patient: I don't have any rectal bleeding, and my appetite is normal. I do notice that certain foods, like pasta with creamy sauce, seem to trigger my diarrhea, and I've had some issues with constipation as well. My weight has been pretty stable, though I could stand to lose about 25 pounds.
Doctor: Have you undergone any stool tests, such as a fecal calprotectin or occult blood test, to evaluate for inflammatory bowel disease or other gastrointestinal conditions?
Patient: No, I haven't had any stool tests like fecal calprotectin or occult blood tests. I didn't even know those were options until today. My primary care doctor just did a regular blood test four months ago, but nothing related to my stool.
